expectedIssues: The word Restaurants is misspelled Restarants
reportedIssues: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, with its title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or peek-shadow to signal that the row is horizontally scrollable.
The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no visual cue that more categories exist.
The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red dot badge but no visible text label or apparent accessible name, and the badge state may not be announced to screen readers.
The 'Popular right now' card images bleed edge-to-edge while the 'Fastest near you' cards have rounded corners and padding, creating a slightly inconsistent card treatment between sections.
